description: Rename a project. Requires Admin API key.

description: Archive a project (revokes its API keys). Requires Admin API key.

description: List API keys belonging to a project. Requires Admin API key.

description: Get details of a project API key (metadata only). Requires Admin API key.

name: openai_rag_query
description: SUPER TOOL: Embed query → search a vector store → generate an answer using only retrieved context. Returns answer + sources. One-call RAG pipeline.

name: openai_batch_embed_and_store
description: SUPER TOOL: Generate embeddings for an array of texts AND upload each as a file attached to a vector store. Returns batch_id for monitoring indexing.

name: openai_assistant_thread_complete
description: SUPER TOOL: Create thread + add user message + create run + poll until complete + return final assistant response. End-to-end assistant call in one tool.

name: openai_structured_extraction
description: SUPER TOOL: Extract a JSON object matching a JSON Schema with automatic retry on parse failure. Uses response_format json_object. Returns parsed object on success.

name: openai_fine_tune_pipeline
description: SUPER TOOL: Upload JSONL training (and optional validation) files + create fine-tuning job. Returns file IDs and job ID for monitoring.
